pairs.summary: Olig2 and ZNF708 motifs co-occur in the same accessible ~300 bp windows more often than expected after matching GC, accessibility and repeat content, in 5 of 14 profiles analysed (786-O clear-cell renal carcinoma; K562 chronic myelogenous leukemia; MDA-MB-468 triple-negative breast cancer; Zhang2021 hepatic tissue | Endothelial (Exocrine Tissues); ...). Median lift 1.32x, typical spacing ~52 bp between sites. In 5 profile(s) the enrichment is seen in both replicate halves and the motifs are distinguishable. This is a sequence-level hypothesis to test (e.g. ChIP/CUT&RUN co-binding, motif mutagenesis), not a confirmed interaction.
